entries.ab0811762ed694d6: The bank is advancing its medium-term management plan, 'Regional and Kōgin 'Mirai' Phase I: Sharing the Outlook', which covers the 3-year period from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026. Viewing THE BANK OF KOCHI as a new-generation terminal where regional 'wakuwaku' (= value) gathers, its basic strategies include strengthening consulting with dedicated specialist staff, redesigning customer experience through a review of the branch network and digitalization, and reforming personnel systems based on human capital management.

For the fiscal year ended March 2026, ordinary income by service was ¥10,942 million from loan operations, ¥7,698 million from securities investment operations, ¥6,206 million from leasing operations and ¥3,531 million from others. Ordinary income from domestic external customers exceeds 90% of consolidated ordinary income, and the business is centered on domestic customers.
